prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop landing-page direction comp, 1440×900 landscape
Primary request: Render an edge-to-edge polished but intentionally familiar SaaS landing page for “Quản Lý Dạy Thêm”, a Vietnamese product that manages multiple tutoring centers, classes, schedules, teaching sessions and attendance. The visitor must understand the offer immediately and have a clear route to sign in.
Real content: headline “Vận hành trung tâm dạy thêm, rõ ràng từ một nơi”; primary action “Đăng nhập”; secondary action “Xem tổng quan”; proof metrics “5 trung tâm”, “28 lớp hôm nay”, “398 / 412 đã điểm danh”. Use only these product claims—no testimonials or invented customer logos.
Composition: use the expected category pattern at high craft: compact top navigation, offer-led headline and actions on the left, a credible product dashboard preview on the right, then a concise feature and metric strip visible below the fold line. The dashboard preview should show multi-center filtering, today’s classes, current session states and attendance completion. Keep every region at real reading size and make sign-in the dominant next action. Include a restrained product mark and navigation labels “Tổng quan”, “Vận hành”, “Bảo mật”.
Visual system: white ground, near-black text, clear blue primary action, teal success states, clean grid, crisp line icons, modern Vietnamese-friendly sans-serif, precise spacing and subtle borders. This is the category standard executed impeccably, not an experimental art direction.
Constraints: readable Vietnamese, functional website UI, no browser chrome, no device mockup, no stock-photo people, no glassmorphism, no loud gradient, no watermark.
